facts.text: Hotel Van Zandt is in the Rainey Street Historic District of Austin.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Van Zandt, nestled in the lively Rainey Street Historic District, celebrates creativity and individuality, embodying Austin’s vibrant music scene and culture.

facts.text: The Rainey Street District is known for its historic charm, bars, live music venues and nightlife.
facts.excerpt: Explore the best of Austin at Hotel Van Zandt in the Rainey Street District, renowned for its historic charm, trendy bars, iconic attractions, live music venues, and buzzing nightlife.

facts.text: The hotel's accommodations are artistically designed, and the hotel hosts live performances.
facts.excerpt: Our artistically designed accommodations, live performances, and exceptional Southern hospitality weave the city’s stories into every detail.

facts.text: The rooftop pool has lounge chairs and private cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Soak up the sun and stretch out on our plush lounge chairs or unwind in one of our premium private cabanas.

facts.text: Pool View King rooms look out over the hotel's rooftop pool.
facts.excerpt: Our Pool View King rooms greet you with a stunning view of our sparkling rooftop pool, setting the perfect tone for your Austin adventure.

facts.text: Geraldine's, on the hotel's fourth floor, hosts intimate performances, jazz brunches and DJ sets.
facts.excerpt: Located on our 4th floor, enjoy intimate performances, jazz brunches, and DJ sets featuring the best local talent.

facts.text: Live music at Geraldine's runs Thursday through Sunday.
facts.excerpt: Step into Geraldine’s, where the heart of Austin’s iconic music scene comes alive every Thursday through Sunday.

facts.text: Geraldine's serves Modern Mexican cuisine with Southern influences and has live music seven days a week.
facts.excerpt: Experience rich culinary heritage, showcasing Modern Mexican cuisine infused with Southern influences and live music 7-days a week.

facts.text: Geraldine's serves modern Mexican cuisine with Southern influence alongside live music.
facts.excerpt: At Geraldine’s, experience a mix of live music and modern Mexican cuisine with southern influence.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a record player, a vintage upright piano and a poker table.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the record player, vintage upright piano, or poker table, and create unforgettable memories, whether hosting a soirée or soaking in the oversized tub.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a living room, a kitchenette and a dining area.
facts.excerpt: Revel in expansive, stylish spaces with a chic living room, sleek kitchenette, and dining area perfect for legendary nights.

facts.text: The One Bedroom Spa Suite's en-suite bathroom has an oversized soaking tub and a walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt: In the en-suite bathroom, indulge in a spa-like experience with an oversized soaking tub and a walk-in shower.

facts.text: The Spa Queen/Queen Junior Suite has two queen beds and a seating area.
facts.excerpt: With two comfy queen-size beds and a plush seating area, you’ll have all the space you need to unwind in style.

facts.text: Corner King rooms have a spacious layout and a walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt: Our Corner King rooms offer a spacious layout and a walk-in shower.

facts.text: The Pool View King High Floor room has a contemporary design infused with local flair.
facts.excerpt: This room’s chic, contemporary design, infused with local flair, sets the stage for an unforgettable stay

facts.text: Brass Poppy is a cocktail lounge in the hotel lobby, open daily.
facts.excerpt: Located in the vibrant lobby of Hotel Van Zandt in downtown Austin, Brass Poppy is an elevated neighborhood cocktail lounge open daily.

facts.text: Brass Poppy combines art-nouveau design with modern sophistication.
facts.excerpt: Host an intimate reception or cocktail event at our extraordinary venue, where the timeless allure of art-nouveau design meets modern sophistication.

facts.text: Café 605 serves locally roasted coffee and house-made pastries.
facts.excerpt: Start your morning with locally roasted coffee and house-made pastries at Café 605

facts.text: The Rooftop Bar offers poolside dining, drinks and private poolside cabanas.
facts.excerpt: We are proud to offer our guests a rooftop poolside dining experience at The Rooftop Bar. Enjoy dining, drinks and even private poolside cabanas.

facts.text: In-room dining is available daily.
facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy in-room dining daily.

facts.text: The hotel provides valet parking; self-parking is not available.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Van Zandt provides valet parking. Self-parking is **not** available.

facts.text: Braille and tactile signage is provided for permanent rooms and spaces.
facts.excerpt: Braille and tactile signage provided for permanent rooms and spaces

facts.text: An accessible One Bedroom Spa Suite has a separate bedroom and living area, an accessible tub and a roll-in shower.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a separate bedroom and living area in our accessible One Bedroom Spa Suite. Featuring an accessible tub, roll-in shower with grab bars, and handheld shower head.

facts.text: The hotel's event venues host corporate retreats, intimate celebrations and weddings.
facts.excerpt: offering the perfect backdrop for corporate retreats, intimate celebrations, and grand weddings.

facts.text: Hotel Van Zandt branded merchandise is sold in the lobby near Brass Poppy.
facts.excerpt: From tee shirts to totes, take in a little retail therapy with our Hotel Van Zandt branded merch, located in the lobby near Brass Poppy.

facts.text: Brass Poppy features live music from resident DJ Ben Green.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy live music from resident DJ Ben Green alongside handcrafted cocktails, premium champagne, and chef-driven bites in a sophisticated lounge setting.

facts.text: The hotel describes its rooms and suites as canvases of comfort and eclectic style for creative souls.
facts.excerpt: they’re canvases of comfort and eclectic style designed for creative souls and adventurous spirits.

contradictions.note: p1 says Geraldine's music runs every Thursday through Sunday; p9 says live music 7 days a week

sources.excerpt: Step into Geraldine’s, where the heart of Austin’s iconic music scene comes alive every Thursday through Sunday.
Experience rich culinary heritage, showcasing Modern Mexican cuisine infused with Southern influences and live music 7-days a week.
